verdict.rationale: Heap documents server-side REST APIs that work without a browser or UI: track, bulk track (up to 1000 events per request), identify, account properties, and user deletion (up to 10,000 users per request). Scripts or CI jobs could call these to automate data ingestion and GDPR deletion. However, there is no CLI, no CI integration, and no headless way to run analyses or reports, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on all paths. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless mode, documented CI/automation workflows, programmatic query/report access, a published OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration.
